column1: # ncz-gpu-names.tsv - curated display-class GPU names for installer feedback.
# WHY A CURATED TABLE: the installer does not ship pci.ids, so a generic
# vendor:device lookup cannot produce a product name. Rather than guess, this
# table names only the GPUs we have actually seen/validated on the fleet, and
# post-install/lib/gpu-progress.sh falls back to the always-truthful numeric
# form "<Vendor> [vvvv:dddd]" for everything else. Never invent a name here.
# The driver DECISION is emitted separately (ncz_gpu_step_profile), not here.
